newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWB in A$10 mln deal for China grain terminal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWB in A$10 mln deal for China grain terminal.

text.p: The Australian Wheat Board (AWB) and construction firm Transfield Holdings Pty Ltd have together won a A$10 million contract to build a grain terminal in southwest China, the AWB said on Wednesday.
The contract for the proposed terminal at Fang Cheng, in the Guangxi autonomous region, is central to a World Bank-financed programme to modernise China's grain-handling system, it said.

"That contract...puts the AWB-led consortium in a good position to win the contract for construction at Dalian, the next contract to be let in the scheme and worth an estimated A$253 million," the AWB said.

The consortium was joined this week by Hitachi Plant Engineering and Construction to bid for the full range of mechanical, electrical and control components of the Dalian grain terminal, the AWB said.
